beginner.stem: Where does the catalog say Oxygen was made before Earth existed?

Lithium is fragile, and stars destroy it more readily than they make it.

beginner.stem: Which of these is a listed use of Oxygen?

beginner.stem: Who does this catalog credit for finding Oxygen?
beginner.explanation: The catalog credits Joseph Priestley for Oxygen.

beginner.stem: How does the catalog describe the discovery of Oxygen?
options: Johan August Arfwedson analyzed petalite from Utö in 1817 and, after removing silica and alumina, was left with a sulfate that was neither sodium nor potassium.
Joseph Priestley focused sunlight on mercuric oxide, which he called mercurius calcinatus per se, and collected a gas in which a candle burned violently and a mouse lived longer than in ordinary air.
Sulfur was gathered from volcanic ground and from the roasting of sulfide ores long before it had a place in a list of elements.
Jöns Jacob Berzelius was following an impurity in the sulfuric acid made at Gripsholm from Falun pyrite.
beginner.explanation: Joseph Priestley focused sunlight on mercuric oxide, which he called mercurius calcinatus per se, and collected a gas in which a candle burned violently and a mouse lived longer than in ordinary air.

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Oxygen in this catalog?
options: Two Paths to the Same Gas
beginner.explanation: Carl Wilhelm Scheele prepared a lively gas and was slow to publish. Joseph Priestley, working another way, told the world first and gave the gas a theory Scheele did not share.

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Oxygen in this catalog?
beginner.explanation: A popular theory said that burning objects gave off a mysterious substance. Antoine Lavoisier followed the new gas through the fire and argued the opposite.

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Oxygen in this catalog?
beginner.explanation: Lavoisier thought every acid had to contain the new gas, and he named the gas for that belief. The belief failed, and the name stayed anyway.

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Oxygen in this catalog?
beginner.explanation: Once oxygen had a name, it explained more than a brighter candle. Bodies, ores, and furnaces were all doing versions of the same taking-up.

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Oxygen in this catalog?
beginner.explanation: A ground test of a new spacecraft in 1967 was supposed to be a rehearsal on the pad. The cabin air was not the mixture the crew breathed on an ordinary day.

beginner.explanation: Oxygen has 6 stored lines.

beginner.stem: Which curriculum note is written for Oxygen at this depth?
options: Find Selenium (Se, Z=34) on the table and note its family (Nonmetal).
